_comment: Tier-2 for skfem hyperelasticity#2, verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1. Claim: P = mu(F - F^-T) + lam lnJ F^-T; putting S = mu(I - C^-1) + lam lnJ C^-1 into int P:grad(v) dx omits an F pre-multiplication and 'Newton diverges'. Ran: MeshTri().refined(3), ElementVector(ElementTriP1), 162 DOFs, mu=lam=1, left edge clamped, right edge stretched 5% and 20%, Newton driven by the exact PK1 tangent for both residuals. Printed: F@S reproduces P to 3.6e-16 (the missing factor really is F, since F C^-1 = F^-T) while S and P themselves differ by 1.4e-01. But 'Newton diverges' is FALSE: the S-in-PK1-slot Newton converges monotonically to residual ~8e-16 at both stretches (14 and 32 iterations) with no NaN and an EMPTY warning list, only at a constant LINEAR rate (ratios ~0.09 at 5%, ~0.29 at 20%) instead of the correct quadratic rate, and it lands on a different displacement field (4.5e-03 relative at 5% stretch, 1.4e-02 at 20%). This is the silent-wrong-answer shape: every internal check passes and nothing is printed. Fixture asserts convergence-order degradation plus a solution that moves, and asserts that the wrong residual does NOT diverge and does NOT warn. MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 applies the documented fix at the pathology site inside residual_form(), giving the bare pk2(F) its missing left multiplication by F (T becomes einsum('ik...,kj...->ij...', F, pk2(F)), which this fixture measures to equal P to 3.6e-16). Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1: the unmutated run matches all 14 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 removes 's05_answers_differ=True', 's20_answers_differ=True' (and raises the forbidden 'FAIL:') so the fixture goes red. NOTE the mutated run converges quadratically yet s05/s20_pk2_ratio_is_constant_linear_rate stays True, because that check tests only whether the residual ratios lie within 0.05 ABSOLUTE of each other, which a collapsing quadratic sequence (ratios 0.001, 0.000, 0.019) satisfies too -- it does not actually separate linear from quadratic order. Re-run: T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py
